name: St. Tammany Parish, LA
findings: St. Tammany Parish has 733 nonprofit organizations. 279 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 228 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, St. Tammany Parish has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few education organizations list public events
observations.text: 3 education organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 13 would.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through education groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 50 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 50 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in St. Tammany Parish list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
